title: What a Cybercab actually charges for a 15-minute trip in Austin
title_candidates: The price difference between Cybercab and Uber on the same 15-minute ride
What a Cybercab actually charges for a 15-minute trip in Austin
The moment a Cybercab rider checked their fare against Uber
How much less a Cybercab costs when it is carrying real passengers
A Cybercab rider compared their fare to Uber on the exact same route
caption:
A real Cybercab ride in Austin cost $9.65. The same 15-minute Uber trip, including tip, came in at $21, putting the Cybercab 54% cheaper.

The Cybercab has no driver, so there is no tip to add. Even Tesla's own Model Y autonomous ride on the same route was $16.99, and the dedicated Cybercab still beat it. The car has no steering wheel and no pedals. You sit down, and it drives itself.

This is one of the first real fare comparisons from actual passengers in Austin, and the gap between robotaxi and rideshare is wider than most people were expecting.
